sliding_window_rate_limiter.name: Atomic Sliding-Window Rate Limiter (Lua Script)
sliding_window_rate_limiter.description: ZREMRANGEBYSCORE + ZADD rate limiter script executing atomically on Valkey
sliding_window_rate_limiter.luaScript: local key = KEYS[1]; local now = tonumber(ARGV[1]); local window = tonumber(ARGV[2]); local limit = tonumber(ARGV[3]); local clearBefore = now - window; redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', key, 0, clearBefore); local currentRequests = redis.call('ZCARD', key); if currentRequests < limit then redis.call('ZADD', key, now, now); redis.call('EXPIRE', key, math.ceil(window / 1000)); return 1 else return 0 end;
